name: Aberration
description: Creatures with utterly alien anatomies, abilities, mindsets, or goals — beholders, mind flayers, slaadi.

name: Beast
description: Nonhumanoid creatures that are part of the natural fauna — wolves, bears, dinosaurs, giant insects.

name: Celestial
description: Creatures from the Upper Planes — angels, couatls, pegasi. Most are good-aligned by nature.

name: Construct
description: Beings made by the use of magic to imitate life — golems, animated objects, modrons.

name: Dragon
description: Large reptilian creatures of ancient origin and tremendous power — true dragons, drakes, wyverns, dragon turtles.

name: Elemental
description: Creatures native to the elemental planes — air, earth, fire, water elementals; mephits, genies.

name: Fey
description: Magical creatures closely tied to the forces of nature — dryads, satyrs, blink dogs, sea hags.

name: Fiend
description: Creatures of the Lower Planes — demons, devils, hell hounds, rakshasas. Most are evil-aligned by nature.

name: Giant
description: Towering humanoids of immense strength and size — hill giants, ogres, ettins, trolls.

name: Humanoid
description: The most common creatures, including most player-character species — humans, elves, dwarves, goblins, orcs.

name: Monstrosity
description: Frightening creatures not truly natural and almost never benign — owlbears, gorgons, manticores, gnolls.

name: Ooze
description: Gelatinous creatures that rarely have a fixed shape — gelatinous cubes, black puddings, gray oozes.

name: Plant
description: Vegetable creatures, not the ordinary flora — awakened trees, treants, shambling mounds, myconids.

name: Undead
description: Once-living creatures brought to a horrifying state of undeath through necromancy or some unholy curse — skeletons, zombies, vampires, liches, ghosts.
